function guideScreen(){return `

PLAYER’S MANUAL

CURRENT VERSION ${gameVersion}

KNOW THE RULES.

01 / SURVIVE THE RUN

Start with five lives. Remaining lives carry between levels; retries restore five. Defeat each opponent with ten correct answers, each dealing 10% damage. Questions continue until the opponent falls or your lives run out. Wrong answers and expired timers cost one life. Read the explanation before continuing; its timer is stopped.

02 / BUILD YOUR STREAK

Correct answers start at 100 points. The multiplier rises every three consecutive correct answers, up to ×5. A mistake resets the streak. Boss levels double answer points. A perfect level adds 500 + 50 × level points.

03 / MASTER THE GATES

Seven overlapping knowledge stages span 75 levels each. Questions gradually progress from recall to context and multi-passage reasoning as reviewed content becomes available. Earlier subjects remain in rotation. Every fifth level is a Gatekeeper round, prioritizing Tradition, Context, and Misquote Traps. Combat timers are unchanged; mastery ranks follow the completed-level milestones below.

04 / USE YOUR ARMORY

Start each run with three 50:50 uses, two +15-second boosts, and one shield. Two consecutive flawless clears (ten correct, no mistakes) restore one use to the most depleted starting stock (ties: 50:50, time, shield), then reset the flawless streak. Stocks stay capped at 3 / 2 / 1; a full inventory gives no extra use. Mistakes, defeat and restarting an incomplete level break the streak. Previously completed levels do not earn duplicate restoration rewards. The shield protects one question from life loss, but a wrong answer still breaks your streak. Pause freezes the clock. Hiding the tab pauses automatically.

Ranks are earned by clearing levels.

Novice: 0–34 completed. Student: clear 35. Scholar: clear 110. Scribe: clear 185. Master 1st Degree: clear 260. Further Master degrees arrive after each additional 75 completed levels: 335, 410, 485, 560 and onward. Points never buy promotions. Earned wardrobes and rank badges persist; earlier honors are labeled legacy. Armor milestones are separate.

Scripture is the answer authority.

The traditional 80-book KJV collection includes 39 Old Testament, 27 New Testament, and 14 Apocrypha books. Baruch includes the Letter of Jeremiah; the Song of the Three Holy Children includes the Prayer of Azariah. Tradition, Context, and Misquote Traps test the cited text respectfully. Each initial ten-question selection targets seven questions about commandments, Torah, Sabbath, feast days, clean and unclean, obedience, or contextual reading, plus three general questions. It seeks two traps, or three at Gatekeeper levels, as the eligible pool permits.

${difficultyCounts.map(d=>`
${d.count}${['','FOUNDATION','CHALLENGER','CONTEXT'][d.difficulty]}
`).join('')}

${questions.length} passage-reviewed questions in this release. No unverified question generation. Each battle starts with ten distinct questions and selects additional questions as needed, avoiding encounter repeats when the eligible pool permits. Selection balances difficulty, recent exposure, topics and delayed review of missed questions. Answer positions are shuffled. The current bank has three reviewed content tiers; advanced stages need additional reviewed questions. Repetition remains possible in a small bank.

${button('← BACK TO TITLE','title','button')}
`}
